headline: MF: Interest rates of up to 7.50% on lei-denominated issues for the first edition of the FIDELIS program this autumn
summary: The first FIDELIS edition this autumn offers investors rates of up to 7.50% on lei-denominated issues and up to 6.30% on euro-denominated ones, according to the Ministry of Finance.
why: FIDELIS is a retail government bond programme run by Romania's Ministry of Finance, so its coupon levels indicate the sovereign's domestic funding costs and retail demand for its debt.
